ShortProject.title: ShortProject
ShortProject.description: A user-owned 20-second vertical AI short video project with script, voiceover settings, and timed captions.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the project owner.

topic.description: Sanitized prompt or topic used to generate the short (1-500 chars).

style.description: Creative format style for the short.

durationSec.description: Target short duration in seconds (10-30, default 20).

backdropTheme.description: Visual backdrop preset for rendered frames.

voiceoverScript.description: Full spoken narration script for AI voiceover (1-1200 chars).

scenes.description: Ordered list of up to 8 timed caption scenes covering the short duration.

securityVerified.description: True when sanitized by InputSanitizer and attested by App Check.

/users/{userId}/shorts/{shortId}.description: User-isolated short video projects owned strictly by userId.
